Method of Attack: Encrypts files using AES-256 encryption and appends .RENSENWARE extension
Ransom demand requires victim to score over 0.2 billion in the Lunatic level of TH12 ~ Undefined Fantastic Object game to decrypt files
Monitors the 'th12' process memory to check game score and level
Does not delete shadow volumes or prevent file restoration
Encryption key is lost if ransomware process is terminated before meeting ransom condition
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with C: drive targeted
